reason: An ACP integration bundle that makes the DeepSeek Harness agent available as a configurable Paseo provider with model discovery, planning and execution modes, reasoning controls, slash commands, streaming updates, and subagent support.

summaries.zh: 通过 ACP 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 Paseo，提供模型自动发现、规划与执行模式、思考强度、斜杠命令、实时事件流和子代理支持。
summaries.en: Connects the DeepSeek Harness agent to Paseo through ACP with automatic model discovery, planning and execution modes, reasoning controls, slash commands, streaming events, and subagent support.

capabilities: Connects Paseo to the DeepSeek Harness agent through ACP over stdio
Automatically exposes dsh model catalogs, execution modes, and reasoning settings in Paseo
Forwards dsh slash commands and streams agent text, reasoning events, and tool-call updates
Uses dsh-managed DeepSeek credentials and can surface bash, file, and search tool activity
